svg.title: The two hooks, gate in and gate out
svg.desc: Gate in is the session-start hook. When Claude Code opens a session it points a stable link at the installed plugin, then compares the plugin's version with the project's and tells you when they differ or when an old copy-install is still there. Gate out is the pre-push check, run before every push Claude makes. It checks what the push adds for secrets in any new line, files that must never leave the machine, permission changes in settings.json, and a plugin older than the project. Any hit blocks the push and asks you; otherwise the push goes out.
